rule: Five encounter shapes, all read from server code plus data counts. AMBUSH: a group flagged MANUAL_SPAWN (0x04) starts off on each map; a smart action 131 forces it on, 132 turns it off. CAMP: one creature_formations row per member (leader, member, dist, angle, groupAI bits, two points); the leader does not start moving while a living member is engaged or evading; assist bits 0x001 and 0x002 make the pack join a fight. PATROL: waypoint points carry a delay in ms that stops the spline and counts down by the frame diff; a point event fires by percent chance. LAIR: linked_respawn row (dependent, master, linkType); a dependent whose master is still dead is re-queued to the master's respawn time plus urand(5,60) seconds; a self-link is re-checked one day later. ESCORT (FollowerAI): first check after 2500 ms, then every 1000 ms; the escort fails and despawns when no leader or group member is within 100 yards; combat pauses the check.

data_fields.name: group_flags_bitmask
data_fields.unit: flags (assist member-to-leader 0x001, assist leader-to-member 0x002, evade together 0x004, respawn on evade 0x008, follow leader 0x200)

keep: Manual spawn groups: a zone group off by default, turned on by a server event, spawned all at once.
Leader waits for engaged members before it moves (the pack moves as one).
Assist bits as data: the pack joins when one member is hit.
Lair gate re-queues the minion to the boss's respawn time instead of dropping it.
Escort head start (2500 ms) and 1000 ms check interval.
Group flags as one bitmask per group.
change: Escort fail is silent in the donor; show a warning and a return window instead.
Lair gate should show the waiting minion as a greyed marker, not as absence.
Respawn offsets are minute-scale in the donor; cap them to our zone pacing.
Dead flags in the donor (DYNAMIC_SPAWN_RATE, ESCORTQUESTNPC) must not be copied; each flag we add needs one reader and one test.
groupAI is copied as uint8 in three places; use uint16 in ours.
Flag and file names are ours (pack_assist, pack_evade, zone_group_manual).
look_test: Build one flag on the existing fight scene. Three looks at the fight camera at 375 wide: A, a camp of three in a wedge in front of the hero, joined within one second of the first hit; B, a camp of three in a ring with a slow angle wobble of about 20 percent of spacing; C, a lair of one boss and two minions, the minions greyed while the boss is up and appearing after it falls. Ask Dom which silhouette reads as bound to whom, and whether C reads as waiting. Target src/fight/pack.ts, row 4.
